### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the user experience or design capability you wish to enhance.

### Proposed Solution / Visual Direction
Describe the proposed design engineering solution, animation interaction, or layout.

### Governing Principles & Directives
Check all that apply:
- [ ] Strictly follows Zero-Jank Motion (60/120fps, transforms and opacity only)
- [ ] No `transition: all` used
- [ ] Tactile feedback on pointer-down
- [ ] Mobile first-class (`dvh` units, `@media (hover: hover)`)
- [ ] Accessible and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`

### Additional Context or Figma References
Add any links, Figma frames, or motion references.
